verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents its own graphical apps (iPhone and Android on-device apps, a Windows desktop app, and a macOS desktop app). Its documented chat paths, however, are a CLI one-shot chat and an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server, and no evidence describes what those apps do or confirms they offer a chat window. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the desktop/mobile apps provide a chat interface, details of GUI chat features (multi-turn history, model selection), and screenshots or hands-on corroboration of a working GUI chat.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: Windows: desktop app + native engine (C++ + Vulkan)
macOS: local CLI / daemon / desktop app (Rust)
iOS: on-device iPhone app (Swift + MLX Swift)
